title: Adjuvant Steroid Outcomes in Idiopathic Subglottic Stenosis
official: Adjuvant Steroid Outcomes in Idiopathic Subglottic Stenosis
summary: This study will examine the ability of steroid injections into the site of stenosis following surgical dilation to delay the need for repeated surgical dilations.
